title: postcodElapse - Usage guide
text: just ELAPSE Land Use Regression model. Estimating concentration PM2.6, BC, NO2 & O3 air pollutants, across Europe 100x100meter resolution. ELAPSE published Kees de Hoogh allowed ’s use postcodElapse. model stored Tiff grey-scale image multiple layers: BCFULL NO2FULL O3FULLa O3FULLc O3FULLw PM25FULLt ELAPSE contains three layers O3 due ’s prescience atmosphere affected seasons. Typically warmer(w) climate O3 concentration tend higher. layer names w warm, c cold average. concentrations stored ELAPSE use unit: µg/m3.

title: postcodElapse - Usage guide
text: Now idea postcodElapse lets get pollution estimates. demo assume downloaded postcode database postcodElapse . main function postcodElapse() pass postcode database return pollution estimates. Ill using BAG postcode UMCG Gronningen. See code , yes simple. take minute, get data. Oke function tells thinks database . recognizes BAG PC6, can manually override guessing passing databases acronym database_type argument. pollution estimates output data.frame. columns layers ELAPSE split across average(avg), minimum(min) maximum(max) pollution concentration, row contains single postcode. n column amount buildings found postcode. Now lets run trough 100 postcodes PC6. don’t make postcodes included demo data. See code load . Even tough used PC6 output BAG. want test postcodes file postcodes1000.rda also present extdata.

code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Basic usage pollutionFromBag("9726AC", "bag-light.gpkg")  # Plotting the location of all buildings, # I recommend you use tidyverse & tidyterra library(tidyverse) library(tidyterra) library(postcodElapse)  data <- pollutionFromBag("9726AC", "bag-light.gpkg")  elapse <- loadElapse()  ggplot() +    geom_spatraster(data = elapse$NO2FULL) +    geom_sf(data = data, aes(geometry = geom), colour = "red") } # }

what: Estimate air pollutant concentraions for a given Dutch postcode. — postcodElapse
title: Estimate air pollutant concentraions for a given Dutch postcode. — postcodElapse
text: Estimates air pollutant concentration given Dutch postcodes. Using ELAPSE (included) postcode database (-included). Two postcode databases formatted Geopackage (.gpkg) supported Postcode6(PC6) Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen(BAG) download one point database  argument location. PostcodElapse automatically guesses type argument, can set "PC6" "BAG".

title: Estimate air pollutant concentraions for a given Dutch postcode. — postcodElapse
Estimate air pollutant concentraions for a given Dutch postcode. — postcodElapse
text: postcodes String containing Dutch postcode (1234AB) can also vector. elapse_path empty ELAPSE stored extdata used. Otherwise use one provided. database Path postcode database, see Postcode database . type Type postcode database, defaults "GUESS" postcodElapse fills type "BAG" Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen "PC6" Postcode6.

title: Estimate air pollutant concentraions for a given Dutch postcode. — postcodElapse
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Estimate air pollution for postcode "8933DV" with Postcode6. postcodElapse("8933DV", "cbs_pc6_2024.gpkg")  # Estimate air pollution for multiple postcodes with BAG. postcodElapse(c("8933DV", "9713 GZ", "1071XX"), "bag-light.gpkg")  # Note postcodes are valid a long as they are four numbers followed by two letters. # In addition any spaces will be removed and non-capital letters will be capitalized. postcodElapse(c("8 9 3 3 DV", "9 713 Gz", "1071 xx"), "cbs_pc6_2024.gpkg") } # }
